name: Hikawadai
tagline: Shinjuku in 23 minutes and Shibuya in 28 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Nerima City, where Tokyo Metro run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 32 minutes to Otemachi, 23 minutes to Shinjuku, 28 minutes to Shibuya and 49 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 27.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 9.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 27.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 26.3 m to 35.7 m, a difference of 9.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 東京武蔵野病院, about 15 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 練馬総合病院, about 34 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line also call here. Both lines are run by Tokyo Metro, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line runs at 153% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 東池袋→護国寺, which this station is not on. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line runs at 117%. Its busiest stretch is 要町→池袋, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 2LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For how little of the area is in the flood projection, Shin-Sakuradai; for rail connections, Hikawadai.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Hikawadai in a straight line. Shin-Sakuradai has only the Seibu Yurakucho Line, so Hikawadai is the better connected. To Otemachi, for instance, Shin-Sakuradai takes 5 minutes longer. A one-room flat also costs about ¥6,000 more at Shin-Sakuradai. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, though, Shin-Sakuradai comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For how little of the area is in the flood projection, Sakuradai; for rail connections, Hikawadai.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Hikawadai in a straight line. Sakuradai has only the Seibu Ikebukuro Line, so Hikawadai is the better connected. To Toranomon, for instance, Sakuradai takes 4 minutes longer. A one-room flat also costs about ¥8,000 more at Sakuradai. On the number of medical facilities, though, Sakuradai comes out ahead.

goodFor: People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: 池袋谷原線 (1 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
